editionLabel: ABACUSSPIELE Leo Goes to the Barber, English rules
firstPlayerRule: The player with the longest hair goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The player with the shortest hair keeps the clock; that is a separate role. Turns proceed clockwise.
If another day is needed, the player who would have taken the next turn becomes its starter.

internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://abacusspiele.de/produkt/leo-muss-zum-friseur/. Finding: The player with the longest hair goes first. Local source SHA-256: ddd91f757a58cb392738c6803c3f915519a6324e6096b9eba9448489a70676c1. The English manual linked from the German Leo muss zum Friseur product identifies the cooperative lion-and-barber game, matching inventory Leo 191538. This successful primary source replaces the failed dV download lead; it is not a second edition record.
